database.note: Shared throughput across all containers below (none have dedicated throughput) -- cheap at this project's scale, isolated from the account's other databases (IncidentRCA, lineage).

containers.description: Current master record -- one document per demand, upserted on each ingestion. Document id == DemandID (enables direct point-reads).
containers.note: StaleDays (Dataverse's/SharePoint's computed-column equivalent) is intentionally NOT stored -- computed in rules.py from LastContentChangeDate at read time.

containers.description: Append-only daily snapshot. Document id == '{DemandID}::{SnapshotDate}', making upsert_item idempotent by construction -- re-ingesting the same file twice overwrites an identical document rather than duplicating it.
Audit trail -- append-only. Document id == the InteractionLog.interaction_id (a fresh UUID per entry).
Cache of display_name -> email resolutions from Microsoft Graph. Document id == a filesystem-safe encoding of DisplayName (enables direct point-reads).
